hold_text: Touches .github/workflows/system-actions.yml and a money-DB backfill tool; the manager merges.
why: Manager decision 2026-11-19 15:28Z: build the group mode as a held PR with tests (opt-in only, refuse on any mismatch, provenance exchange_fill / group-allocated). WHY: alpaca_paper QQQ 7780/7781/7782 (735/55/7 sh) + 7783 (2 sh) closed together on the US-open gap; backfill-own-fill-exits dry run #27355 SKIPped each ('no attributable close fill'), because no row's own qty equals an order. Every share of one venue order fills at that order's price, so pricing all rows from ONE order whose fills sum to their combined qty stays MEASURED. WHAT: plan_group() + --group (needs --ids >= 2); action wrapper ACTION_GROUP; system-actions.yml parses a `group:` body key (validated true/false) and passes it to the remote command; docs/claude/system-actions.md row. Refuses: < 2 rows, a row failing _skip_reason, mixed account/symbol/direction, closes > 300 s apart, no order or two qualifying (exit_from_one_order_fills), and (found by the new test) a filled qty not EXACTLY the group's: the per-row QTY_TOLERANCE is 5%, which accepted a 797-sh order for a 799-sh group. Without group: the action is unchanged (per-row SKIPs, tested). Tests: tests/test_backfill_own_fill_group.py 6 passed; 15 related test files 630 passed (test_phone_drill needs fastapi, absent in this sandbox). canonical-doc-coherence, no-action-rate-cap, workflow-actor-guard, workflow-failure-swallow rc 0 (same on main). No apply here: 7780-7783 stay UNMEASURED until this merges, then a dry run goes to the manager. Gates this adds or changes: none.
